subject: .github/workflows/retornatus.yml
source:
python3 -c '
from pathlib import Path
text = Path(".github/workflows/retornatus.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
needles = [
    "contents: read",
    "pull-requests: write",
    "persist-credentials: false",
    "a4b3e88c779afe3933b27b1e3610952d6e41bcb1 # v1",
    "version: \"1.9.1\"",
    "dependabot[bot]",
    "governance.omission.bot_exemption",
]
missing = [item for item in needles if item not in text]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit("missing: " + ", ".join(missing))
print("workflow review ok")
for item in needles:
    print("present:", item)
'
